summary.text: Carl Turner is a Republican who has represented Kansas House District 28 in Johnson County since 2021.
He chairs the Legislative Modernization Committee and is vice chair of the Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Turner's occupation is financial, process improvement and project management.
He also serves on the Health and Human Services Committee, the Joint Committee on Information Technology and the 2025 Special Committee on Taxation.
